overview_description.description:
Grab pieces of enjoyable content from any page, save them online, and share without having to copy/paste using a simple bookmarklet.  For bloggers and media sites, Snipd's widget enables readership to Snip images, videos, or text enjoyed most within articles.

Snipd content becomes a destination for users, rather than a list of bookmarks because users are able to enjoy what they saved from within pages on the net.

With more and more content to sift through these days, Snipd makes it easier to identify hot-zones in articles.  Hot-zones are dumbed-down heat maps for content.  Readers can forget skimming and focus on what people are Snipping most on any page. Because a snip is an implicit vote on a piece of content, we aggregate and figure out what area of an article is attracting the most attention.

product.name: Snipd AI-powered Podcast Player
product.description: A web-based application that uses AI to capture, summarize, and organize insights from podcasts and other audio content.

product.name: Audio Content Upload and Import
product.description: A feature allowing users to upload audiobooks, personal recordings, and import YouTube videos to apply Snipd's AI capabilities beyond podcasts.

product.name: Insight Export and Integration
product.description: A service that exports and syncs saved podcast insights with popular note-taking applications in Markdown format.

product.name: Episode Interaction via Chat Interface
product.description: A chat feature that lets users ask questions and retrieve insights from episodes they have listened to.

product.name: AI-generated Episode Summaries and Auto-chapters
product.description: AI-generated summaries and chapters that provide overviews and navigation aids for podcast episodes.
